name: Xavier Xenophon
source:
Xavier is Lord Sovereign Marshal of the armies of the Lusanti. Hailed as the greatest military commander of the age, many look to him to keep the [url=https://vndb.org/c165578]King[/url] under control. The King and Xavier's friendship was cemented during the last war with Temeria. This led to a peace treaty and the marriage of King Hugh and [url=https://vndb.org/c165583]Queen Kailyn[/url].
